title: matterbridge-yzj plugin
description: Bridges yzj-agent devices (KNX / 米家 / 涂鸦 / Lutron / etc.) into Matter via the Matterbridge dynamic-platform API.

yzjAgentUrl.title: yzj-agent URL
yzjAgentUrl.description: Base URL of the local yzj-agent FastAPI. Default http://127.0.0.1:9200 (same Mac mini).

categoryAllowlist.title: Category allowlist
categoryAllowlist.description: Which yzj device categories to bridge to Matter. Defaults cover all controllable types.

deviceIdBlocklist.title: Device ID blocklist
deviceIdBlocklist.description: Specific yzj device_ids to exclude. Use '{adapter}.{native_id}' format (e.g. 'xiaomi.979836693' to skip a Mi AI Speaker that has category=switch but is not a controllable switch).

debug.title: Debug logging
debug.description: Verbose endpoint logging. Heavy — only enable for troubleshooting.

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister on shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Whether to unregister all bridged endpoints when Matterbridge stops. Default false (keep iOS pairings stable across restarts).
